title: Maximum Xor Of Two Numbers In An Array
statement:
Given a nonempty integer array `nums`, return the maximum bitwise XOR of any two values. The same index may be chosen twice, so a one-element array has result zero.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [3,10,5,25,2,8]
Output: 28
```

```text
Input: nums = [14,70,53,83,49,91,36,80,92,51,66,70]
Output: 127
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 2 * 10^5`
- `0 <= nums[i] < 2^31`
